name: XLA_JE_CATEGORIES
description: This table contains Journal Categories for a combination of an event class and an application.

columns.name: APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Functional area within a software suite of products. For example, Financials or Payroll.

columns.name: LEDGER_ID
columns.description: Self-contained accounting information set for single or multiple legal or management entities.

columns.name: ENTITY_CODE
columns.description: Unique abbreviated name assigned to an entity and used for reporting or in reference to an option.

columns.name: EVENT_CLASS_CODE
columns.description: Unique abbreviated name assigned to an event class and used for reporting or in reference to an option.

columns.name: JE_CATEGORY_NAME
columns.description: Group of journal entries with similar characteristics such allocations, accruals, or revenues.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: PROCESSING_UNIT_SIZE
columns.description: Indicates the number of documents to be processed at a time, as a batch, while creating accounting entries.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
